message: Hi! I want to try jiu jitsu for myself. How do I start?
Hey! That's awesome you want to try Jiu-Jitsu! I'm Emma from the front desk. We make it super easy to get started with a free trial class, no experience needed. What's your name?
Hi Emma! I'm Tester Vermilion. I'd love to sign up for that free trial class.
Perfect, Tester! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
I already shared my name—it's Tester Vermilion. What else do you need?
You're right, sorry about that! I've got Tester Vermilion. Can I grab your email address?
Got it! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Perfect! Last thing - what's your date of birth? This just helps us keep everything organized.

Awesome! I've got you all set up. Let me show you some open times for your free trial class. Here are a few options:

- Tonight Monday 7/6 at 6:45 PM
- Tuesday 7/7 at 6:45 PM
- Wednesday 7/8 at 6:45 PM
- Friday 7/10 at 6:00 PM

Which one works best for you?
I'll take the class tonight, Monday 7/6 at 6:45 PM. Looking forward to it!
Perfect! You're all booked for tonight at 6:45 PM. We're at 195 S Westmonte Dr #1108 in Altamonte Springs. Just wear comfortable workout clothes and come ready to have fun. See you soon!
